title: Cost Tuning & FinOps for Data Platforms

scenes.heading: Cost Tuning & FinOps
scenes.narration: FinOps brings financial accountability to the cloud, making sure your data platform stays reliable at a cost the business can actually afford.

scenes.heading: Where data costs hide
bullets: Full-table scans from missing partition filters
Data stored forever with no lifecycle policy
Redundant pipelines recomputing the same tables
scenes.narration: A huge share of warehouse cost comes from full-table scans caused by missing partition filters. Idle or oversized always-on clusters quietly bill you around the clock. Data kept forever with no lifecycle policy inflates storage indefinitely, and redundant pipelines that recompute the same tables waste compute nobody notices.

scenes.heading: The FinOps loop
scenes.narration: The FinOps cycle starts with informing, attributing spend to teams and pipelines so costs are visible. It moves to optimizing, cutting the waste those insights reveal. Finally it operates, enforcing budgets and automating guardrails so savings stick instead of eroding over time.

scenes.heading: Two levers for savings
scenes.narration: On the compute side you right-size clusters, autoscale to real demand, and run interruptible spot instances for work that can safely retry. On the storage side you tier cold data to cheaper classes, compress and partition to shrink scans, and expire stale datasets automatically. Attacking both levers usually yields the largest, most durable savings.

scenes.heading: Attribute cost with tags
scenes.code:
-- Break down warehouse spend by team and pipeline
SELECT
  tags['team']     AS team,
  tags['pipeline'] AS pipeline,
  SUM(bytes_scanned) / POW(1024, 4) AS tb_scanned,
  SUM(credits_used) AS credits
FROM query_history
WHERE start_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY credits DESC;
scenes.narration: This query rolls up spend by team and pipeline using cost-attribution tags on each query. Ranking by credits used immediately surfaces the biggest consumers, which is where optimization pays off most. Without this kind of attribution, cost is just one opaque monthly number that nobody feels responsible for.

scenes.text: Make cost a visible, owned metric. What gets attributed gets optimized — and reliability you can't afford isn't reliable.
